War Ghoul [SAB] - Ally (Tzi) (3)
If you have no other allies and no retainers in play when War Ghoul is
recruited, then you burn War Ghoul to satisfy card text.

Does that mean you pay the pool cost and then burn, or just burn?

Stravinsky [Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Tzimisce
Capacity: 9
Discipline: ANI AUS VIC pot
Sabbat Archbishop of Mexico City: Stravinsky gets an additional +1
bleed when bleeding a Methuselah who controls a younger ready Tzimisce.
+1 bleed.

If my prey has a younger Tzi and I bleed him and he deflects to his
prey, do I bleed my grandprey witht hat extra 1 or is it lowered to
only +1 bleed? And the same thing if it was the other way around, i.e.
my grandprey is the Tzi.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <91a9gn$fqg$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, cantila
<rogc...@student.luth.se> writes

>War Ghoul [SAB] - Ally (Tzi) (3)
>If you have no other allies and no retainers in play when War Ghoul is
>recruited, then you burn War Ghoul to satisfy card text.
>
>Does that mean you pay the pool cost and then burn, or just burn?

You pay the cost then burn the War Ghoul.

>Stravinsky [Sabbat, SW]
>Cardtype: Vampire
>Clan: Tzimisce
>Capacity: 9
>Discipline: ANI AUS VIC pot
>Sabbat Archbishop of Mexico City: Stravinsky gets an additional +1
>bleed when bleeding a Methuselah who controls a younger ready Tzimisce.
>+1 bleed.
>
>If my prey has a younger Tzi and I bleed him and he deflects to his
>prey, do I bleed my grandprey witht hat extra 1 or is it lowered to
>only +1 bleed? And the same thing if it was the other way around, i.e.
>my grandprey is the Tzi.

The bleed total is calculated based on the Methuselah you are currently
bleeding. If you are bleeding a Methuselah controlling a Tzimisce, you
get +2 bleed. If you are not, only +1 bleed. This changes as necessary
when you are bounced.
